author: zhou-jianwen
name: Denia Portrait
description: An unofficial animated head-only Denia portrait with expressive task states and sixteen look directions.
variant_note: An independent V2 animated head-and-hair portrait with expressive task states and sixteen look directions.
source_notes: Independently AI-generated interpretation of Denia from Wuthering Waves for request #340. The requested headshot is interpreted as a complete animated head-and-hair portrait. The requester collage supplies appearance guidance. Its original artist, publication and redistribution permission are unverified. Final sprite pixels are produced with the built-in image_gen tool and native transparency, followed by intact-pose extraction, source-grid retiling and deterministic V2 assembly. Visual generation workers were configured as gpt-6-luna and gpt-6-sol with medium reasoning. Blind review workers were configured as gpt-6-luna with medium reasoning. The image tool backend model is undisclosed. Left and right drag animations are independently generated to preserve the anatomical-left ornament. zhou-jianwen is the AI-assisted adapter. Underlying character and source-art rights remain with their respective owners. Non-commercial fan use only.
